we aim to understand how people diagnosed with bipolar disorder experience personal recovery in their everyday lives, how they express this experience in their language, how they differ in this experience and expression, and how this can be used to inform future interventions.

social media data can provide new insights into the experience of personal recovery, which is a highly relevant topic for clinical practice and policy making.
